attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Board of Pharmacy (Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rules.notes: Registration renews every two years (expires March 31; file by March 15, fee $100) without a CE requirement: the renewal rule (Ph 804.01) asks only for identity, employer, pharmacist-in-charge and conviction information.
rules.rule_quote: (a) All pharmacy technician registrations shall expire biennially on March 31.

rules.alternatives: No state-set hours: the technician must keep national certification (PTCB or NHA) and complete all CE that certification requires; report or copies of CE go with the renewal. Technicians with sterile or non-sterile compounding duties need at least 0.4 CEU in compounding.
rules.audit_note: Keep CE certificates 3 years; at least 10% of certified technicians are randomly audited each year. Excess CE does not carry over.
rules.notes: Certification renews every two years (expires March 31; file by March 15, fee $100).
rules.rule_quote: (a) Certified pharmacy technicians shall maintain their nationally certified status and stay up to date with all continuing education requirements such certification demands.

rules.alternatives: No state-set hours: must keep national certification and complete the CE it requires. Advanced technicians with compounding duties need at least 0.4 CEU ACPE-approved (0.2 CEU each calendar year) in compounding or other Board-set competencies.
rules.audit_note: Keep CE certificates 4 years; at least 10% randomly audited each year. Reinstatement of a lapsed licence needs 15 hours (5 live) in the prior 24 months.
rules.notes: Licences expire March 31 of even-numbered years; renewal form PT-22 and $100 fee.
rules.rule_quote: (a) All licensed advanced pharmacy technicians shall maintain their national certified status and stay up to date with all continuing education required by such certification demands.
